title: Typography Analysis
content: Selecting fonts for Electric Vehicles (E-bikes) brand voice...

title: Font Pairing
content: Montserrat + Open Sans: Montserrat provides a geometric, urban aesthetic that feels modern and high-tech, perfect for an E-bike brand. Pairing it with Open Sans ensures high legibility and an approachable, democratic feel for body text, making the brand feel inclusive to all riders.

title: Font Pairing
content: Inter + Roboto Mono: Inter is the gold standard for clean, efficient digital interfaces, reflecting the visionary tech aspect of electric vehicles. Roboto Mono is used for accents and technical specs to emphasize efficiency and engineering precision without losing the brand's modern edge.

title: Font Pairing
content: Poppins + Lato: Poppins features friendly, circular geometric shapes that make the brand feel approachable and visionary. Lato provides a warm, humanist contrast for long-form content, maintaining the 'democratic' voice by being highly readable and stable across all devices.

title: Typography Strategy
content: The typography strategy for HECTOR focuses on 'Humanist-Geometric' hybrids. By using sans-serif families that balance technical precision (representing the E-bike hardware) with open, friendly letterforms, we convey a brand that is both cutting-edge and easy to interact with. This selection avoids aggressive industrial tones in favor of a clean, efficient aesthetic that suggests the future of urban mobility is accessible to everyone.

title: Logo Architecture
content: Defining logo structure options for Electric Vehicles (E-bikes)...

title: Structure Option
content: Combination Mark: This is the most effective choice for the EV sector. It combines a unique icon representing energy or movement with the brand name, ensuring high recognition whether the logo is on a website or a bike frame.

title: Structure Option
content: Wordmark: Many modern e-bike brands favor a minimalist, tech-forward aesthetic. A wordmark allows for custom, aerodynamic typography that conveys a sense of speed, efficiency, and modern engineering.

title: Structure Option
content: Monogram: Perfect for premium or high-performance e-bike brands. A monogram provides a compact, scalable mark that fits elegantly on small surface areas such as the head tube, battery pack, or digital display unit.
